description: Defines an abstract base class for search plugins in Drupal, providing common functionality such as setting search parameters, building results, and generating help text.

classes.name: SearchPluginBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for search plugins in Drupal, including setting search parameters, building results, and generating help information.

methods.name: setSearch
methods.description: Sets the search keywords, parameters, and attributes.

methods.name: isSearchExecutable
methods.description: Checks if the search can be executed based on current keywords.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of search, default is NULL.

methods.name: searchFormAlter
methods.description: Allows alteration of the search form.

methods.name: suggestedTitle
methods.description: Generates a suggested title for the search, truncating keywords if present.

methods.name: buildSearchUrlQuery
methods.description: Builds URL query parameters from form state.

methods.name: getHelp
methods.description: Provides help information about the search functionality.

methods.name: usesAdminTheme
methods.description: Indicates whether the plugin uses the admin theme.
